plain_text:
Mandel Kramer appears in 211 recordings across 16 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1940 to 1979. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Mandel Kramer most often in Counterspy, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, CBS Radio Mystery Theater, X Minus One, Gang Busters, The Adventures of the Abbotts, The Chase, and The Falcon.

Characters credited here include Johnny Dollar, Harry Peters, and Sergeant Johnny Gleason.
